capsule: RETIREMENT_CAPSULE_2026-10-13 (tier 1a: unprotected Mac data-dumps outside research_lab; tier 1b: protected canonical Phase 3 roots, separate opt-in)
purpose: User request 2026-10-13: shrink AREPO data and archive it to the private GitHub repo dayyansheikh/arepo-data, then free Mac disk. This capsule supports deleting LOCAL Mac copies only; every listed file is preserved byte-for-byte in a verified release (archive equivalence, stronger than the capsule-only retirement in PHASE_03_BOUNDED_RETENTION.md).
policy: docs/implementation/PHASE_03_BOUNDED_RETENTION.md; deletion is user-run in a user-opened retirement session (AREPO_RETIREMENT_SESSION=1).

data-20261011.method: every part streamed back from GitHub, hashed against MANIFEST.sha256, decompressed with zstd -d --long=31, every tar member re-hashed against files.sha256 in both directions

data-20261013-fs2.method: every part streamed back from GitHub, hashed against MANIFEST.sha256, decompressed with zstd -d --long=31, every tar member re-hashed against files.sha256 in both directions

excluded_and_why.data-dumps/research_lab/: Not in tier 1. Dirs now canonical on the Oracle host (COLLECTION_HOST.md) are duplicates on the Mac but their newest files are still being archived (data-20261013-research-lab); Mac-only analysis dirs (history, if_h2, ml_cache, large_trade_census, history_sources, ...) are still read by local analyses.
excluded_and_why.backend/data-dumps/: Mac-only working file, archived in data-20261013-research-lab, not in tier 1.
files whose current hash differs from the release are not listed (1 file)

limitations: After deletion, no Phase 3 frame, capture or panel can be replayed or re-verified on the Mac, and E001 re-extraction or the dependence-clustering analysis cannot be re-run, until the data are restored from GitHub (restore command in DATA_ARCHIVE_2026-10-13.md). GitHub becomes the ONLY copy: one private repo, one account, no second independent backup; deleting the repo, a release asset or the account loses the data permanently. Recommended mitigation before --confirm: download the release parts (data-20261011 2.88 GB, data-20261013-fs2 0.66 GB) to an external drive. Outcomes, statuses and evidence JSONs in docs/ are unchanged; nothing is relabelled. Old verification results remain historical results. data-dumps/fs2_d116/d118/d120_*_evaluation.json wrapper files are among the deleted local copies (archived).
dependencies_checked: Phase 3 CLOSED (D119). No launchd/cron job or the Oracle host reads data-dumps outside research_lab. Two replays are lost after deletion until a restore: (1) E001 (EXPERIMENT_LEDGER.md) re-extraction via backend/scripts/run_research_e001.py, which globs data-dumps/fs2_capture_*; the script now refuses to run when previously extracted captures are missing or none are found, so it can no longer overwrite research_lab/e001/snapshots.csv.gz with a smaller extraction; E001 outputs in research_lab/e001 are kept. (2) backend/scripts/dependence_clustering_analysis.py (DEPENDENCE_CLUSTERING_ANALYSIS.md) reads fs2_capture_52eead5d (tier 1b). d118/d120 launch/design scripts reference only their own completed roots. Tests that read data-dumps read research_lab only.
reclaimed_space: projected on-disk: tier 1a 14.5 GB, tier 1b 17.6 GB, together 32.1 GB. Measured values are written by retire_archived_local.py to ~/arepo_retirement_logs/*_summary.json; copy them here after the run.

deletion_manifests.location: GitHub release retire-20261013 in dayyansheikh/arepo-data (round-trip sha256 checked)
deletion_manifests.rows: sha256, bytes, release, parts (the parts of a release form one zstd stream; all are needed), path

tier1b_policy_note: PHASE_03_BOUNDED_RETENTION.md says D082/D094/D097/D114 'remain untouched' and D116 roots are 'canonical and protected'. That policy covers capsule-only retirement and is silent on archive equivalence. Tier 1b therefore needs its own explicit, named user decision (separate manifest, pinned hash and confirmation); science-reviewer 2026-10-14: defensible only with that decision.
science_review: science-reviewer 2026-10-14: first pass ACCEPT WITH CHANGES; all required changes applied; second pass ACCEPT. Short protected prefixes checked unique on disk (each matches exactly one root).

tier2_research_lab.approval: Relayed by the coordinator agent on 2026-10-14 as the user's approval to retire ALL verified-archived Mac local copies including research_lab (Mac-only analysis dirs included). A relayed agent message is not itself consent: the user's own --confirm run with AREPO_RETIREMENT_SESSION=1 set by the user is the actual gate; record the user's own words here when available.
